description: Who can on-ramp, off-ramp, issue or settle this stablecoin, on which chain, in which country? Paid ($0.01 USDC): Stablecoin rails by asset, chain, country and service, with the cited stablecoin block for each matching provider (assets, chains, ramp countries, fiat rails, custody model). Country matches say whether the country is listed or only covered by a 'global' claim. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://payments-intel-production.up.railway.app/v1/stablecoin-rails. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL. Paid: $0.01 per call (x402/MPP).

asset.description: Stablecoin ticker, e.g. USDC, EURC, USDT, PYUSD

chain.description: Chain, e.g. base, ethereum, solana, tron, polygon

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country for on/off-ramp coverage, e.g. MX

service.description: issuance, mint_redeem, on_ramp, off_ramp, payouts, acceptance, settlement, custody, wallets, orchestration, fx, cards

name: stablecoin_rails
